articles.title: What Robinhood’s recent layoffs say about the current state of crypto investments
articles.snippet: Despite the trading platform’s restructuring and the wave of crypto companies making cuts, signaling a late bear market, Altcoin Pro’s Horst, Anderson and Zhuleku explain there’s no reason to panic.

articles.title: Tether putting $23 billion gold stockpile to work with bullion-backed loans
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer is extending its tokenized gold strategy by allowing holders of XAUT to borrow against their bullion, mirroring bitcoin-backed lending without selling the underlying asset.

articles.title: Strategy's valuation has fallen below the value of its bitcoin holdings
articles.snippet: For years, investors had valued the firm well above its bitcoin holdings, giving Strategy massive flexibility to raise capital as needed — a situation Michael Saylor and team took full advantage of.

articles.title: Anti-trafficking group says Clarity Act's Section 604 could weaken accountability
articles.snippet: An anti-human trafficking advocate said a Clarity Act provision could weaken accountability despite existing criminal laws.

articles.title: Bitcoin bounces from $58,000 as derivatives signal more pain in the pipeline
articles.snippet: BTC touched its lowest level since September 2024 before rebounding to $59,770, while ETH slipped further and another $1 billion in futures positions were wiped out.
